amendment_not_restated.en: {accession} amends {amends_accession}; it does not restate this figure ({reason}).
amendment_not_restated.zh: {accession}修订了{amends_accession}；该修订未重述此数值（{reason}）。

conflict.en: For {period}, {party_a} reports {value_a} and {party_b} reports {value_b}; both are shown and neither is chosen.
conflict.zh: {period}期间，{party_a}报告{value_a}，{party_b}报告{value_b}；两者均予显示，不作取舍。

first_published.zh: {party}在{form} {accession}（已知日期{date}）中首次公布{period}的数值为{value}。

reassertion.en: The next publication, {form} {accession} (known {date}), repeated the same value {value}.
reassertion.zh: 下一份申报文件{form} {accession}（已知日期{date}）重复了相同数值{value}。

restatement.en: The next publication, {form} {accession} (known {date}), changed it from {old_value} to {value}.
restatement.zh: 下一份申报文件{form} {accession}（已知日期{date}）将其由{old_value}更改为{value}。

footer.en: Quoted from the filing; nothing is inferred beyond the quoted text.
footer.zh: 引自申报文件原文；除引文外未作任何推断。

undisclosed.en: {party} names this relationship but does not disclose its size.
undisclosed.zh: {party}披露了这一关系，但未披露其规模。

concentration_risk.en: If {counterparty} reduces or stops its purchases

exclusivity.zh: 当排他性条款适用或终止时

pricing.zh: 如果定价条款发生变化

volume_commitment.en: If the volume commitments are not met
volume_commitment.zh: 如果未达到采购量承诺

rule: Frozen 2026-10-22 by ORCH-REL before any M2 condition row exists. A described condition is rendered as: premise(kind) + lead_in + the VERBATIM condition text re-derived from a pinned EDGAR excerpt + citation. No consequence, probability, score or advice is ever inferred or added. A quote that cannot be re-derived from pinned bytes is not printed (QUOTE_UNVERIFIED).

scope_note.en: Scope strings (numerator/denominator) are the filing's own English words.
scope_note.zh: 分子/分母范围文字为申报文件英文原文。
